_comment: Deep cavalry formed turn demo: a single 80-mount Cavalry unit staged alone in drill mode at (800, 700) facing north [0, -1]. Given an orderly move order to (500, 290) demanding a ~36-degree formed turn -- deliberately kept under UnitManeuver.MOVING_WHEEL_MIN_ANGLE_DEG (45 deg) so a mounted unit's move order still routes through the ordinary march's own centre pivot (Unit._move_to's pivot_as_formation branch, the depth-scoped Unit._formed_turn_gait_frac-derated path this PR patches) instead of Unit.begin_moving_wheel's separate hinge-translating maneuver. Under depth-scoped corner-slot pacing (Unit._formed_turn_gait_frac) and wide corridor proximity retention, the block maintains column dressing and safe nearest-neighbour spacing throughout the turn and settle.
